author: Unbeatable9mm
quote:
Man, Im actually so disappointed, heartbroken for this game. 12 years and $1.5BN for this:

-30fps at release on PS5 Pro
-720p upscaled to 1080p on Seriesrelying on a new AMD tool. 
-Floor glitches, actually... just all of the glitches, ever seen a 150 meter cargo boat do a quad kickflip?
Rockstar, you used to be great, one of the best, GTA SA, LC, TFLC, 4, 5. All masterpieces by themselves. Why does this game look and feel 10 years old?


I dunno folk, Ill see y'all back in Los Santos 

It gets a plus one for its satire of the red hat global affairs and its soundtrack

author: Unbeatable9mm
quote: Perfection. It always has been, honestly one cannot express just how gorgeous this game is. Timeless
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Unbeatable9mm
quote:
What can I say? The sequel of the greatest game ever made.

Again, another perfect game, the day cycle, the dark undertones, the intrinsic links to the Kubler Ros model of grief.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask

author: Unbeatable9mm
quote:
Single greatest game of all time, this game started it all, pioneered open world adventures, introduced industry defining mechanics and paved the way for every single modern game in some way or another. 

The music, the gameplay, the story, the lore, the foresight. 100/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
